# QuickFixx24

> QuickFixx24 (also written QuickFixx or Quickfixx24) is a service company based in Chittagong, Bangladesh. It offers home repair, tech and CCTV, CNG and car booking, shifting, logistics, events, web development and digital marketing, hotel rooms, legal information and home healthcare. It takes bookings for all 8 divisions of Bangladesh, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and replies within 30 minutes.

Key facts: phone and WhatsApp +880 1805-455811; head office CU 1no Gate, Chittagong 4330, Bangladesh; payment by cash, bKash or Nagad; CNG booking starts at ৳200 and car booking at ৳500; other services are quoted before work starts; free cancellation at least 1 hour before the service.

## Services
- [Home Service](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/home-service/): Book an electrician, plumber, painter or cleaner at home in Bangladesh. ID-verified staff, quote in 30 minutes, open 24/7. Call QuickFixx24.
- [Tech Support](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/tech-support/): CCTV camera installation, computer and network repair, and business software setup in Bangladesh. On-site visit, clear quote, open 24/7.
- [Doorstep Mechatronics](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/doorstep-mechatronics/): Smart home automation fitting and hands-on electronics learning kits for students, brought to your door in Bangladesh. Book a visit with QuickFixx24.
- [Virtual Support](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/virtual-support/): Remote help for software problems, online classes and AI tools. Get support from QuickFixx24 on a call or screen share from anywhere in Bangladesh.
- [Vehicle Booking](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/vehicle-booking/): Book a CNG auto-rickshaw from ৳200 or a car from ৳500 in Chittagong. Open 24/7, reply in 30 minutes. Call +880 1805-455811.
- [Transportation and Shifting](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/transportation-services/): Home, office and business shifting across Bangladesh. Careful packing, loading and transport with a clear quote. Book QuickFixx24.
- [Logistics](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/logistics/): Pickup and delivery for food, groceries and laundry in Bangladesh. Book a rider from QuickFixx24, open 24/7.
- [Event Management and Security](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/event-management-security/): Plan your event with decoration, photography and CCTV monitoring in Bangladesh. Share your date and venue and get a quote from QuickFixx24.
- [Web Development and Digital Marketing](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/web-development-digital-marketing/): Business websites, social media management, SEO and AI-assisted marketing for Bangladeshi businesses. Get a quote from QuickFixx24.
- [Expert Collaboration](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/expert-collaboration/): Drivers, fleet operators, mobility specialists and technicians can join QuickFixx24 as partners and get regular bookings across Bangladesh.
- [Hotel Room Booking](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/hotel-room-booking/): Book rooms managed by QuickFixx in Chittagong. Ask for rates, availability and check-in details by call or WhatsApp.
- [Legal Services](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/legal-services/): Guidance on law, land and rights matters in Bangladesh. Understand your options before you act. QuickFixx24 legal information service.
- [Home Healthcare](https://www.quickfixx24.com/services/home-healthcare/): Home nursing, medical checkups and post-surgery care in Bangladesh. Care at home from trained staff. Not for emergencies: call 999.
